analysis_md:
如图所示所求质心为

示意图：坐标轴标为 $x,y$，原点为 $O$；边界曲线标为 $y=\sqrt{2px}$，竖边位于 $x=x_0$，区域内有斜线阴影。

$$
M=\iint_D\mu\,dxdy=\mu\int_0^{x_0}dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2px}}dy=\frac23\mu\sqrt{2px_0^3}
$$

$$
\bar{x}=\frac{\iint_Dx\mu\,dxdy}{M}=\frac{\int_0^{x_0}x\mu\,dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2px}}dy}{\frac23\mu\sqrt{2px_0^3}}=\frac{3x_0}{5}
$$

$$
\bar{y}=\frac{\iint_Dy\mu\,dxdy}{M}=\frac{\int_0^{x_0}\mu\,dx\int_0^{\sqrt{2px}}y\,dy}{\frac23\mu\sqrt{2px_0^3}}=\frac{3y_0}{8}
$$
